mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Carts (user_idx, product_idx, option_idx, quantity) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{productIdx}, #{optionIdx}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_idx AS cartIdx, c.user_idx AS userIdx, c.product_idx AS productIdx, c.option_idx AS optionIdx, c.quantity, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.price AS originPrice, /* 상품의 원래 가격(정가) */ p.discount_rate AS discountRate, /* 할인가 계산: (정가 * (100-할인율)/100) 한 뒤 10원단위 절삭 */ CASE WHEN p.discount_rate > 0 THEN TRUNCATE((p.price * (100 - p.discount_rate) / 100) / 10, 0) * 10 ELSE p.price END AS price, o.color, o.size, o.stock FROM Carts c JOIN Products p ON c.product_idx = p.product_idx JOIN ProductOption o ON c.option_idx = o.option_idx WHERE c.user_idx = #{userIdx}

SELECT c.cart_idx AS cartIdx, c.user_idx AS userIdx, c.product_idx AS productIdx, c.option_idx AS optionIdx, c.quantity, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.price AS originPrice, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, CASE WHEN p.discount_rate > 0 THEN TRUNCATE((p.price * (100 - p.discount_rate) / 100) / 10, 0) * 10 ELSE p.price END AS price, o.color, o.size, o.stock FROM Carts c JOIN Products p ON c.product_idx = p.product_idx JOIN ProductOption o ON c.option_idx = o.option_idx WHERE c.cart_idx = #{cartIdx}
